name: TomoAnchor V3 Z-Sharded ADMM-GMRES
definition: A GPU-based cone-beam CT reconstruction method that uses TIGRE for forward/backward projections and an ADMM solver with restarted GMRES for the x-update step to handle numerical mismatch between TIGRE's Ax and Atb operators.
summary: TomoAnchor V3 Z-Sharded ADMM-GMRES is a GPU-based cone-beam CT reconstruction method that uses TIGRE for projections and GMRES to solve ADMM x-updates, handling numerical mismatch between forward and adjoint operators.
